name: Pegu Provision Guild
goals: Protect the rice while town buyers are short.
Settle loading and clearance in time for the next leg of the voyage.
bio: Min Ye can put buyers in touch with provision captains who have room to talk. A safeguard for the warehouse does not decide when each crew sails.
notes: fact: Birch reports Pegu merchants asking for protection and separately describes captains sending men to Muar (Birch III, pp. 125–126, 130, 141–142)

inference: Pires’s Pegu circuit leaves Melaka for Pasai in July; Araújo reports September departures, so the roster should not impose one deadline. Delayed rice fleets could threaten food supply (monsoon-calendar.md §3; prices.md §4.2)
gameplay: The guild and Min Ye’s leadership are fictional; the safeguard and Muar contingent need not have identical membership (people-factions.md §§3–4; data/merchants/min_ye.json)
